name: Quantum computing task: Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolarizing error 0
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Build a Qiskit Aer noise model with depolarizing error 0.0048 on single-qubit gates and 0.0401 on CX. Run a 4-qubit GHZ circuit with 8192 shots and compare noisy vs ideal counts. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
